summary: Elemental Royalty Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from its May 27, 2026 Annual General and Special Meeting, as required under Canadian NI 51-102. Items included setting the board at five directors, election of five directors (with 94-99% support each), appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers as auditors, and ratification of the Amended Omnibus Plan. No price, stake, premium, or change-of-control terms are present. This is a routine meeting results filing, not a special situation.
